name: Monu di Xing'ai Qiujin
source:
Master said that I’m full of sexual desire If I want to cure my perverted behavior, I should wear the chastity sheath
“Even the chastity sheath can’t cure you… seems that you need to be trained hard."

I had always been a very horny guy. I would think about H things all day that my master called me a male dog on heat…
But then I suddenly wanted to cure my perverted behavior
Could I succeed?

However, along with the training progress, I felt like I became more horny
Was that normal? Was she… really my master?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683950/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主人說我滿腦子都是慾望，想治好這副好色的德性，就得戴上貞操套。
「連貞操套都治不好你……看來得好好調教才行。」

我一直是個慾望旺盛的傢伙，整天都在想色情的事，主人都叫我發情的公狗……
可我忽然想改掉自己好色的毛病。
我能成功嗎？

然而，隨著調教不斷深入，我反倒覺得自己越來越好色了。
這正常嗎？她……真的是我的主人嗎？
